name: IPSServerTestPlan
title: IPS Server Test Plan
description:
Test plan for the **IPS Server** actor of [HL7 International Patient Summary (IPS) 2.0.1](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/).
An IPS Server is a FHIR server acting as an IPS Creator by providing conformant
IPS documents in response to FHIR API requests (CapabilityStatement ips-server).
Each `suite` below is a `Rule:` of the Gherkin feature named by `suite.input.file`, and each `suite.test` one of its `Scenario:` lines, matched by the scenario's identifier. The assertions are the scenario's `Then` steps, verbatim.
The tests declare which specification obligations they cover (9 element obligations across the plan); the coverage matrix is checked mechanically against the specification package.
purpose: To declare, in a machine-readable and runnable form, which behaviours a system claiming conformance to the IPS Server actor must demonstrate.

scope.description: The IPS Server actor — a FHIR server acting as an IPS Creator through the $summary operation — is the system under test.

suite.name: The server declares the IPS capabilities
suite.description: Rule: The server declares the IPS capabilities — the scenarios grouped under it in the feature file.

test.name: ips-server-001 The CapabilityStatement declares the $summary operation

suite.name: $summary returns an IPS document
suite.description: Rule: $summary returns an IPS document — the scenarios grouped under it in the feature file.

test.name: ips-server-002 $summary by patient identifier returns a Bundle (IPS) with identifier, timestamp and the composition first

assertion.human: $ips should conform to "http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/StructureDefinition/Bundle-uv-ips" ignoring slicing errors

test.name: ips-server-003 The returned Composition is complete and about the requested patient
test.description: Covers Composition-uv-ips: Composition.status, Composition.type, Composition.subject, Composition.date, Composition.author, Composition.title.

assertion.human: $ips at "Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(Composition).all(status = 'final' or status = 'amended' or status = 'preliminary')" should be true
$ips at "Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(Composition).type.coding.where(system='http://loinc.org' and code='60591-5').exists()" should be true
$ipsProfiled should conform to "http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/StructureDefinition/Bundle-uv-ips" ignoring slicing errors

test.name: ips-server-005 An unknown patient is refused, not answered with an empty document

suite.name: The document the server returns meets the Creator obligations
suite.description: Rule: The document the server returns meets the Creator obligations — the scenarios grouped under it in the feature file.

test.name: ips-server-006 The returned document is the input for the Creator test cases

assertion.human: $ips should conform to "http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/StructureDefinition/Bundle-uv-ips" ignoring slicing errors
Client is informed "Continue with ips-creator.feature: use this returned document as the exported IPS." with $ips
